description: Python language support for CPython and GraalPy, https://www.python.org
name: python
notes: Mirror: set VFOX_PYTHON_MIRROR to a python.org mirror, for example
CPython on Linux and macOS: uv-build when the index has the version, else a source build.
A VFOX_PYTHON_MIRROR keeps the source build unless VFOX_PYTHON_UV_BUILD_MIRROR is set.
Set VFOX_PYTHON_USE_UV_BUILD=0 to always build from source, or =1 to use uv-build only.
Set VFOX_PYTHON_UV_LIBC=gnu|musl to override Linux libc detection.
Set VFOX_PYTHON_UV_BUILD_MIRROR to mirror uv-build archive downloads.
GraalPy on Windows is amd64 only; uv-build provides CPython only.
Already installed Python: `vfox link --detect python` (vfox 1.1.0 or later).
Windows launcher: installs are registered with PEP 514 automatically.
Set VFOX_PYTHON_REGISTER_PY_LAUNCHER=0 to disable Windows launcher registration.
